notes: Portable C++ and Java translation of the mapped native timed-save NMRA active-callback resignation guard. The adapter supplies provider, FOM, endpoint, and logical-time implementation. With HLA_EVOKED callbacks, a regulating owner requests a timed save at time 5 and a constrained member requests Next Message Request Available(6). The owner receives grant 5 before save initiation; the constrained member receives Initiate Federate Save before grant 6. Resignation within that active callback is rejected with CallNotAllowedFromWithinCallback. Both members complete the save and receive Federation Saved. Direct traceability is limited to the seven pinned requirement-section pairs in clauses 4.12, 4.19, 4.19.6, 4.20, and 4.23. C++ primary and contract passed against an installed package under integer64 and float64 time. Java compiles against the official API only; provider runtime is unverified. No immediate-callback, FQR/TARA, interoperability, or conformance claim.
